data.name: Rezaa
data.gender_notes: Rezaa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rezaa means satisfaction, contentment, or pleasure. It signifies being pleased with God's will and decree. The name Rezaa carries the meaning “Satisfaction, Contentment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rezaa usually hope their child will grow to embody satisfaction, contentment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic context, Rezaa relates to the concept of Rida, which is God's pleasure or satisfaction, often mentioned in Quranic verses and Hadiths.
data.etymology: Rezaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Satisfaction, Contentment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rezaa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: رضا
in_arabic.meaning: رضا يعني القناعة والرضا بقضاء الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: رضا هو اسم مشتق من الفعل 'رضي' الذي يعني القناعة والرضا بقضاء الله. في الإسلام، يعتبر الرضا من الأسماء الحسنى التي تعبر عن الصبر والقناعة بما قدره الله للإنسان. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية حول العالم، وغالبًا ما يُعطى للأطفال الذكور.

in_urdu.name: رضا
in_urdu.meaning: رضا کا مطلب ہے قناعت اور اللہ کی رضا مندی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رضا ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'رضي' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے قناعت اور اللہ کی رضا مندی۔ جنوبی ایشیا میں مسلمانوں کے مابین، یہ نام اہم مذہبی اور ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ یہ صبر اور قناعت کی خوبیوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: रज़ा का अर्थ है संतुष्टि और ईश्वर की मर्जी
in_hindi.long_meaning: रज़ा एक अरबी नाम है जो 'رضي' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है संतुष्टि और ईश्वर की मर्जी। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है। यह धैर्य और संतुष्टि के गुणों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: رضا
in_pashto.meaning: رضا د قناعت او د الله د رضا معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رضا د عربي نوم دی چی د 'رضي' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، هغه د قناعت او د الله د رضا معنی ورکوي. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کی، دا نوم مهم دی او د صبر او قناعت ښکارندوی کوي.

in_english.name: Rezaa
in_english.meaning: Rezaa means satisfaction and contentment with God's will
in_english.long_meaning: Rezaa is derived from the Arabic root 'R-D-H' which signifies satisfaction, contentment, and acceptance of God's decree. In Islamic tradition, Rezaa is considered a virtuous name reflecting patience, trust, and surrender to divine will. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual maturity and faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rezaa" is rooted in the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic world. It reflects the deep sense of submission and peace that Islam encourages in its followers. Additionally, the name can be seen as a testament to the importance of gratitude and contentment in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Rezaa" signifies a deep sense of satisfaction and acceptance of God's will. It is a reminder that true contentment comes from within, through the recognition of God's infinite mercy and goodness. For Muslims, striving for this state of mind helps deepen their connection with Allah and brings inner peace and tranquility.
